evals.prompt: I have an idea for a feature but I'm not sure if it's needed. Help me figure out if it's worth doing.
evals.expected_output: Problem framing with needs vs solutions, evidence, and handoff-ready problem statement
expectations: Writes context and opportunity artifacts before the PRD, and interview notes only when a human is interviewed
PRD includes evidence, success criteria, assumptions & risks, and in/out scope
